A0.label: S3 as in R139 (the base, for reference; not a new test)

L1.label: liquidity sweep: the down-leg took an untaken swing low or the previous day's low

L2.label: displacement: the CHoCH bar's body >= 1 x ATR14

L3.label: fair value gap left between the low and the CHoCH bar

L4.label: discount: the CHoCH close at or below 50% of the down-leg's range

L5.label: order-block retest entry: wait for price to come back to the last down candle before the turn

V1.label: volume surge: option-chain volume of the last 15 min >= 1.5x the session's average

OF1.label: OI order flow: PCR rose over 15 min (put writing) for a call; fell for a put

OF2.label: buying flow: call volume > put volume over 15 min for a call; the reverse for a put

C2.label: the 60-minute trend is not against the trade

C4.label: R123's N1 network expected value > 0 (2023 on)

D1.label: day stop: after 2 losing trades on an index, no more that day

D2.label: stop cap: skip when the stop is more than 1.5 x ATR14 away

X1.label: exit: index stop + 60% premium lock after +Rs 1,000, no fixed target

X2.label: exit: breakeven at 1R, then a 1R trail, no fixed target

K2.label: flow stack: volume surge + OI flow + buying flow

K3.label: every single filter that beat S3 per trade in design (>= 300 trades), together (L2 + V1 + C1)
